No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

On this walk you consider sacred water, settlement and everyday religious practices.

The date, start time, pace and language are arranged to suit your group.

What it covers

  • Public approach and sacred etiquette
  • Banganga tank public edges
  • Neighbourhood historic architecture
  • Water and community discussion

How the time is spent

  1. Public approach and sacred etiquette 20 min

  2. Banganga tank public edges 40 min

  3. Neighbourhood historic architecture 40 min

  4. Water and community discussion 20 min

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Follow the etiquette expected when approaching a sacred site from public areas.
  • Describe the public edges of the Banganga tank and the historic architecture around it.
  • Discuss the links between sacred water, settlement and everyday religious practice.

You take away

An interpretation sheet with questions to ask on site and suggested reading.
